evidence.quote: Studielink is the official registration and application portal for programmes at Dutch higher education institutions.

entries.notes: Study in NL (Nuffic), section 'Application via Studielink': 'For most programmes you first need to register via the Studielink tool.' The same page warns: 'you should first check with the institution of your choice whether you are required to register via Studielink. Some institutions use a different method to register students from abroad!' It names no institution, so no institution can be excluded from this evidence; the auditor should check the institution page of each programme. The Studielink site (info.studielink.nl/en) says students arrange their own application on Studielink but has no sentence about applicants from abroad, so it is not quoted.
